source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
If each model in your army has **HERETIC ASTARTES** or **CHAOS KNIGHTS**, you may recruit **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** units whatever your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), with these limits:

- Their combined points: up to 250 at Incursion, 500 at Strike Force or 750 at Onslaught.
- None of the allied models may be **WARLORD** or take Enhancements.
- For each of **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE** and **SLAANESH**, the daemon units with that keyword that are not **BATTLELINE** can't outnumber the **BATTLELINE** ones with it.
